title_en: Supreme People's Court's Three Typical Cases on Crimes of Trafficking in Women and Children
keywords_en: rape; cases of crimes of abducting and trafficking women and children
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Three Typical Cases of Crimes of Trafficking in Women and Children

Case 1

Shao Changsheng — Crime of Trafficking in Women

1. Basic Facts

The defendant, Shao Changsheng, male, Han Chinese, born on August 12, 1986, farmer.

On the evening of October 29, 2008, for the purpose of profit, the defendant Shao Changsheng, together with Lu Along (co-defendant, already sentenced) and Lu Xianjie (separately prosecuted), lured the online acquaintance Liu (female, victim), who had come to Wenzhou Railway Station to meet Wei Bin (co-defendant, already sentenced), into a field next to Nanyang Pavilion in Xinan Village, Yantou Town, Yongjia County, Zhejiang Province. The three robbed Liu of 170 yuan in cash. Lu Along then beat Liu, forced her to strip naked, and raped and molested her. Shao Changsheng then also molested Liu. Subsequently, Shao Changsheng and Lu Along respectively beat and threatened Liu, forcing her to agree to engage in prostitution. In the early morning of the next day, Shao Changsheng again molested Liu. On the 30th of the same month, Lu Along contacted Zhou Lanfen (separately prosecuted) and sold Liu to Zhou for 5,000 yuan. Thereafter, Liu was taken by Zhou Lanfen's son, Jin Ningjian (separately prosecuted), to Wukang Town, Deqing County, Zhejiang Province, and forced into prostitution until she was rescued on April 13, 2009.

On December 13, 2008, for profit, Shao Changsheng lured an online acquaintance Li (female, victim) to the Huanglong Hotel in Wenzhou City under the pretext of taking her out to play. Then, together with Lu Along and "Changmao" (separately prosecuted), he lured Li to the forest outside Xinan Village, Yantou Town, Yongjia County, under the pretext of visiting Nanxi River. Shao Changsheng beat Li, robbed her of one mobile phone, forced her to strip naked, and then Shao Changsheng and Lu Along gang-raped Li. They forced Li by violence to agree to engage in prostitution. Later that evening, Lu Along contacted Zhou Lanfen and sold Li to Zhou for 5,000 yuan. Thereafter, Li was taken by Zhou Lanfen's son, Jin Ningjian, and son-in-law, Jin Beiping (separately prosecuted), to Wukang Town, Deqing County, and forced into prostitution until she was rescued on April 13, 2009.

On an evening in early February 2009, for profit, Shao Changsheng, Jiang Renjian, Hong Pengchao (co-defendants, both already sentenced), and Hong Pengfei (separately prosecuted) lured Hong Pengfei's girlfriend (victim, identity unknown) to the forest outside Xinan Village, Yantou Town, Yongjia County. Shao Changsheng and Jiang Renjian beat the victim, forced her to strip naked, and gang-raped her. Then, using the pretext that Hong Pengfei owed a debt, they forced her to agree to engage in prostitution to repay the debt. Afterwards, they took her to the Shunfa Inn at No. 266 Xianqing Road, Yantou Town. The next day, Shao Changsheng contacted a buyer and sold the victim to Deqing County for 5,000 yuan.

At about 5:00 p.m. on February 14, 2009, Hong Haiwei (co-defendant, already sentenced), under the pretext of inviting them to dinner, arranged to meet his online game acquaintances Jiang and Duan (both female, victims) at the New South Bus Station in Wenzhou. Then, Jiang Renjian and Hong Haiwei lured the two victims to Yantou Town, Yongjia County. The defendant Shao Changsheng and Yin Nannan (co-defendant, already sentenced) arrived later and met them in Yantou Town. At about 7:00 p.m. that evening, the four persons, including Shao Changsheng, took the two victims to the forest outside Xinan Village, Yantou Town, beat them, robbed them of over 100 yuan in cash, two mobile phones, one digital camera, and other items. Then they forced the two victims to strip naked and gang-raped them. Later, by violence, they forced the two victims to agree to engage in prostitution. At about 11:00 p.m., Hong Pengchao, Hong Pengfei, and "Huangmao" (separately prosecuted) also arrived at the forest outside Xinan Village, Yantou Town, and joined them. At about 0:00 a.m. the next day, the seven persons, including Shao Changsheng, took the two victims to the Shunfa Inn at No. 266 Xianqing Road, Yantou Town, and except for Hong Pengchao and Hong Pengfei, the others again gang-raped the two victims. That day, Shao Changsheng contacted Zhou Lanfen and sold the two victims to Zhou for 10,000 yuan. Thereafter, the two victims were taken by Jin Ningjian and Jin Beiping to Wukang Town, Deqing County, and forced into prostitution until they were rescued on April 13 of the same year.

At noon on February 27, 2009, Jiang Renjian, under the pretext of introducing a job, lured an online acquaintance Pan (female, victim) to the "Heavenly Bird" Internet Cafe near Jiangjun Bridge in Wenzhou City. That evening, Jiang Renjian and Yin Nannan, under the pretext of celebrating a friend's birthday, lured Pan and another woman (victim, identity unknown) to a lawn by the water tower in Xinan Village, Yantou Town, Yongjia County. The defendant Shao Changsheng, Hong Haiwei, Hong Pengchao, and others arrived later and joined them. Shao Changsheng and others beat the two victims, robbed them of over 10 yuan in cash, two mobile phones, and other items, then forced them to strip naked. Shao Changsheng, Jiang Renjian, Hong Haiwei, Yin Nannan, and others gang-raped the two victims, and later, by violence, forced them to agree to engage in prostitution. In the early morning of the next day, Shao Changsheng and others took the two victims to the Shunfa Inn at No. 266 Xianqing Road, Yantou Town, where Shao contacted Zhou Lanfen and sold Pan to Zhou for 7,000 yuan. Thereafter, Pan was taken by Jin Ningjian and Jin Beiping to Wukang Town, Deqing County, and forced into prostitution until she was rescued on April 13 of the same year. The other victim was also sold by Shao Changsheng to a buyer in Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province, for prostitution, and Shao Changsheng and others obtained 3,500 yuan from the sale.

On an evening in late March 2009, Hong Haiwei and Yin Nannan, under the pretext of celebrating a friend's birthday, lured an online acquaintance (female, victim) to the lawn behind the substation in Xinan Village, Yantou Town, Yongjia County. The defendant Shao Changsheng, Jiang Renjian, and Hong Pengchao arrived later and joined them. Shao Changsheng and Hong Pengchao beat the victim, forced her to strip naked, and Shao Changsheng, Jiang Renjian, Hong Haiwei, and Yin Nannan gang-raped her and forced her to agree to engage in prostitution. Afterwards, they took the victim to the Shunfa Inn at No. 266 Xianqing Road, Yantou Town. The next morning, Shao Changsheng contacted a buyer and sold the victim for 4,500 yuan.

2. Judgment

The court held that the defendant Shao Changsheng, together with others, abducted women for the purpose of selling them, constituting the crime of trafficking in women. Shao Changsheng also, for the purpose of illegal possession, used violence to rob the trafficked women of their property, constituting the crime of robbery, and should be punished with combined punishments for multiple crimes. In the joint crime, Shao Changsheng participated in trafficking eight women, actively committed acts of beating, threatening, and gang-raping the victims, was responsible for contacting buyers and negotiating transaction prices, and also robbed six of the victims. He was the principal offender with the most prominent status and role in the joint crime and the most serious culpability. Moreover, he trafficked multiple women, raped the trafficked women, and sold the trafficked women to others to force them into prostitution. The circumstances of the crime were particularly serious, the social harm was extremely great, and the crimes committed were extremely grave, warranting severe punishment according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Shao Changsheng was found guilty of the crime of trafficking in women and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property; for the crime of robbery, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of twelve years, with deprivation of political rights for three years and a fine of 5,000 yuan. The combined punishment was execution of the death penalty, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property. Upon review and approval by the Supreme People's Court, the criminal Shao Changsheng was lawfully executed on February 23 of this year.

Case 2

Xiao Yuande, Xiao Yuanfu, et al. — Crime of Trafficking in Children

1. Basic Facts

The defendant Xiao Yuande, male, Han Chinese, born on January 19, 1975, farmer.

The defendant Xiao Yuanfu, male, Han Chinese, born on January 5, 1979, farmer.

The defendant Zhou Zhiwen, male, Han Chinese, born on November 24, 1978, farmer.

The defendant Xie Yaojun, male, Han Chinese, born on June 22, 1988, farmer.

The defendant Yan Maosheng, male, Han Chinese, born on November 22, 1979, farmer.

At about 4:00 p.m. on October 21, 2008, the defendants Xiao Yuande, Xiao Yuanfu, and Yan Maosheng conspired to traffic a child. Then they drove a motorcycle to the vicinity of Gaotang Industrial Park, Yuancheng District, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province, to look for a target. When they arrived at a fruit stall on the side of National Highway 205 at the Gaotang Resettlement Site in Yuancheng District, Xiao Yuanfu spotted a child, Huang (male, then 2 years old), suitable for the crime. He telephoned Xiao Yuande to meet him. Then Xiao Yuande pretended to buy fruits to distract the attention of Huang's mother, while Yan Maosheng took the opportunity to pick up Huang and fled on the motorcycle driven by Xiao Yuanfu in the direction of Yihe Town, Dongyuan County, Guangdong Province. Thereafter, Xiao Yuande and Yan Maosheng hired the car of defendant Zhou Zhiwen to transport Huang to Lianping County, Guangdong Province. Xiao Yuande contacted a buyer and sold Huang for 26,000 yuan. Xiao Yuande paid Zhou Zhiwen 1,000 yuan as a transportation fee, and divided the remaining proceeds equally with Xiao Yuanfu and Yan Maosheng. On May 2, 2009, Huang was rescued by the public security organs and returned home.

At about 8:00 p.m. on February 26, 2009, the defendants Xiao Yuande, Xiao Yuanfu, Zhou Zhiwen, Xie Yaojun, and Liu Guoquan (separately prosecuted) conspired to traffic a child. Then they drove a white car (license plate: Yue PU1589) driven by Xie Yaojun to the Industrial Avenue of Mingzhu Industrial Park, Yuancheng District, Heyuan City, to look for a target. When they found Wen (male, then 2 years old) playing near a barbecue stall on the side of the industrial avenue, after being assigned tasks by Xiao Yuande, Xiao Yuande and Xiao Yuanfu pretended to buy barbecue to block the stallholder's view, while Zhou Zhiwen took the opportunity to pick up Wen and fled in Xie Yaojun's car toward Lianping County. On March 5 of the same year, Xiao Yuande contacted a buyer and agreed to sell Wen for 26,000 yuan. The buyer paid 6,000 yuan in advance, and Xiao Yuande and the others divided the proceeds equally. On May 2, 2009, Wen was rescued by the public security organs and returned home.

At about 8:00 p.m. on April 3, 2009, Xiao Yuande proposed to traffic a child near Huangzidong Market in Heyuan City urban area. Xiao Yuanfu, Zhou Zhiwen, and Xie Yaojun agreed. Xie Yaojun drove a white car (license plate: Yue PU1589) carrying Xiao Yuande, Xiao Yuanfu, and Zhou Zhiwen to "Tangxing Commodity Store" on Wanlvhu Avenue in Heyuan City urban area. Xiao Yuande selected a child, Tang (male, then 3 years old), near the store as the target. Zhou Zhiwen and Xiao Yuande successively went to the store, pretending to buy things to distract the store owner's attention, while Xiao Yuanfu took the opportunity to pick up Tang and fled in Xie Yaojun's car toward Lianping County. About a week later, Xiao Yuande sold Tang through another person for 27,000 yuan, and divided the proceeds equally with the co-defendants. Later, the buyer suspected that Tang was trafficked and returned Tang, demanding a refund. The four persons, including Xiao Yuande, agreed, and Xiao Yuande returned 20,000 yuan to the buyer. When they learned that Tang's family was searching everywhere for Tang, the four persons, including Xiao Yuande, returned Tang to the roadside near Huangzidong on April 30 of the same year. Later, Tang was claimed by his family at the public security organ.

2. Judgment

The court held that the defendants Xiao Yuande, Xiao Yuanfu, Zhou Zhiwen, Xie Yaojun, and Yan Maosheng, for the purpose of selling, jointly stole young children for trafficking, constituting the crime of trafficking in children. Among them, Xiao Yuande and Xiao Yuanfu participated in trafficking three children; Zhou Zhiwen and Xie Yaojun participated in trafficking two children; Yan Maosheng participated in trafficking one child. In the joint crime, Xiao Yuande organized and planned the crime, contacted buyers and directed the division of the spoils, playing a primary role, and was the principal offender, and should be punished for all crimes in which he participated. Xiao Yuanfu, Zhou Zhiwen, Xie Yaojun, and Yan Maosheng played secondary roles and were all accessories. After being brought to justice, Zhou Zhiwen disclosed others' crimes and led the public security organs to arrest co-defendants, thus performing meritorious service. In the third criminal activity, Xiao Yuande, Xiao Yuanfu, Zhou Zhiwen, and Xie Yaojun, intimidated by judicial authority and social pressure, voluntarily returned the child, showing repentance. Accordingly, the defendant Xiao Yuande was sentenced to life imprisonment for the crime of trafficking in children, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property. The defendants Xiao Yuanfu, Zhou Zhiwen, Xie Yaojun, and Yan Maosheng were given lighter or mitigated punishments according to law, sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment ranging from thirteen to six years, and fined.

Case 3

Cai Shunguang — Crime of Purchasing a Trafficked Woman

1. Basic Facts

The defendant Cai Shunguang, male, Han Chinese, born on December 3, 1980, farmer.

In the morning of a day in the fourth lunar month of 2008, in a remote forest at Houmen Mountain, Changsha Natural Village, Yanting Village, Xiahu Town, Xiapu County, Fujian Province, the defendant Cai Shunguang purchased the trafficked victim Wang from "Chen Wei" (separately prosecuted) for 33,000 yuan to be his "wife." When the public security organs, upon receiving a report from the victim's father, went to rescue Wang, Cai Shunguang had already transferred Wang in advance to a rented house in Yanwo, Songcheng Street, Xiapu County, where Wang was placed under the custody of Cai Shunguang's mother, Lin Shuiyu. Cai Shunguang himself went to work on a fishing boat in Haidao Township, Xiapu County. On January 3, 2010, the public security organs rescued Wang from Cai Shunguang's rented house. Two days later, Wang gave birth to a baby boy, who is now being raised by Lin Shuiyu. Wang has returned to her place of origin. On February 1 of the same year, Cai Shunguang was arrested by the public security organs in a rented house in Haidao Township, Xiapu County.

2. Judgment

The court held that the defendant Cai Shunguang, knowing that the victim Wang was a trafficked woman, purchased her and, by transferring her, obstructed the rescue, constituting the crime of purchasing a trafficked woman, and should be subject to criminal liability according to law. After purchasing Wang, Cai Shunguang did not abuse or maltreat her and intended to form a stable marital and family relationship with her, which could be considered as a ground for leniency. In summary, based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and social harm of Cai Shunguang's crime, the defendant Cai Shunguang was sentenced to eight months' fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of purchasing a trafficked woman according to law.
